messages.subject: grid.arrange and legend position
parts:
Hi,

I have this simple script:
…
g_legend<-function(a.gplot){
  tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(a.gplot))
  leg <- which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  legend <- tmp$grobs[[leg]]
  return(legend)}

legend <- g_legend(p1)
 
p5 <- grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(p1 + theme(legend.position="none"),
                               p2 + theme(legend.position="none"),
                               p3 + theme(legend.position="none"),
                               p4 + theme(legend.position="none"),
                               ncol=2), legend,  heights=c(10, 1))


The legend is plotted in the middle between p3 and p4 overlapping a bit these plots. How can I shift the legend the right side of the plots.

Thx.
